description: This file defines the CRPDF class responsible for generating PDF documents in Chromium via the Playwright project. It includes functions for converting print parameters, manages PDF generation options, and interacts with the Chromium DevTools Protocol.

classes.name: CRPDF
classes.description: Class responsible for generating PDFs using Chromium DevTools Protocol.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a PDF buffer based on provided page options.
